messages:
alice: Hi team — ACME's vendor risk asked for our SOC 2 (Type II) report and a temporary bridge letter for the POC. They also want presigned S3 access to a few artifacts. Can we confirm what we can share and what legal needs for NDA?
ben: @alice quick answer: we can share SOC2 summary + redacted report under signed NDA. For a bridge letter we need a legal review; I can produce a short ack (no attestation) but legal requires customer legal entity, scope, and expiry. Please confirm the customer's legal name.
carla: Security note — prefer presigned links with <=7d expiry, IP allowlist if ACME can provide IPs, and redaction of any internal credentials or IPs from artifacts. We can also provide a sanitized evidence bundle instead of raw evidence.
dan: For the POC I can spin up a staging tenant and generate short-lived API keys. Suggest minimal evidence checklist to keep the bundle small: network diagram (redacted), mapping to SOC2 controls, KMS/encryption notes, and access logs truncated to 90 days. Example presign command if needed:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-sanitized.zip --expires-in 259200
```
zara: ACME security (cc procurement) asked for SOC2 pdf, bridge letter, and live S3 links. They said they will sign NDA within 24h but prefer minimal redaction — can we accommodate? This is time-sensitive.
ben: Send NDA to me first. If it's our standard NDA we can countersign same day. If they add custom indemnity/rights clauses will need 48–72h. Bridge letter template (draft): "Redwood Inference confirms it has completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering period [period]. Subject to an executed NDA and limited to the named recipient, Redwood provides an acknowledgement of report availability and does not offer an attestation or opinion. This acknowledgement expires on [expiry date]." I can adapt once I have the exact customer name and expiry window.
alice: @dan please prepare the sanitized bundle and presign links. @carla confirm 7-day expiry hard limit or flexible. @ben i'll upload the NDA draft when ready.
access-bot: Presigned link created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/acme-sanitized.zip?X-Amz-Signature=EXAMPLE (expires in 3 days)
carla: Reviewed the bundle @dan — please remove employee IDs from logs (replace with hashed IDs) and strip any full KV/cache dumps. Also redact internal feature flags. After those edits I approve.
dan: Done edits, uploaded `acme-sanitized-v2.zip` and `control-matrix.csv`. I'll only share links to ACME once NDA is countersigned.
zara: Sending NDA to our legal now. One procurement ask: can the bridge letter be valid for 14 days from signing? They need that window documented.
ben: We normally do 7 days but can make an exception to 14 days for POC customers. Marking as expedited — I'll include a clause for the 14-day validity and route for quick review.
alice: Thanks — plan: ben to prepare bridge letter + countersign NDA if standard, dan to hold links until countersign, carla to greenlight bundle. Target: NDA countersigned + links live by EOD tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
zara: Sounds good, ping me if legal asks for anything else.
